title: angular-django2 OpenUI table schematic
description: Compile an OpenUI table element into a standalone OnPush Angular Material table component. Writes <name>-table.ts (component, column and page types, Django REST framework helpers), <name>-table.html (Material table, filter field, paginator) and <name>-table.scss to <path>/<name>-table. The host supplies the columns and the rows and handles the sort, filter and page outputs.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a table node; behaves.sort, behaves.filter and behaves.paginate select the generated features.

name.description: Kebab-case name for the table component. Defaults to the dasherized id of the table node.

path.description: Destination directory within the selected application's source root.

project.description: Target application project. Required when more than one application is available.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first table element.
